'''Kal kals''' are a fried sweet traditionally made during Christmas in Christian communities of [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|India]].

==Ingredients==
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (280 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) white wheat [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ cup (120 g) [[Cookbook:Powdered sugar|powdered sugar]]
* ½ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* ½ cup (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Oil|oil]]

==Procedure==
# Combine flour, egg, baking powder, powdered sugar, and vanilla to make a moist but not sticky [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# Flatten teaspoon-sized balls of dough on the back of a fork (preferably with rounded tines) and roll off, forming small snail-shell-like curls.
# [[Cookbook:Deep frying|Deep fry]] in hot oil (~350°F/180°C), six at a time, until golden brown.
# Roll in more powdered sugar while still hot to coat.

==Warnings==
*When deep frying, be careful not to splash hot oil on yourself.
